letmereplace.config.hotkeys.comment.stac:
Hold, in the Box in schematic tool mode, and scroll
to add copies of the box toward where you look
letmereplace.config.hotkeys.comment.move:
Hold, in the Box in schematic tool mode, and scroll
to move the box toward where you look (sneak: a box length)
letmereplace.config.hotkeys.comment.undo:
Undo the last change to the schematic edited last,
or cancel a pending stack or move
letmereplace.config.hotkeys.comment.redo: Redo the last change Undo took back
